features.quote: Two pits dug through the plaster floor of Building 7300
features.subtype: pits (two), cut through floor of Building 7300

date.basis: publication: the pits produced 10th-9th century B.C. sherds (Iron Age)

notes: One entry codes both Iron Age pits (same description, same attributes). Position: the 1973 work was 'in the area of the North-West Gate' (p. 243) and Building 7300 flanks that gate; the only direction the publication gives is the gate's name, coded NW from the unit (a quadrant edge). No distance given. Fig. 1 (p. 244) is a schematic plan of Building 7300 only (north arrow, 10 m bar); the unit's recorded point cannot be placed on it, and the pits are not drawn. No pool or grave is mentioned. No absence statement.
